about.heading: About Me
about.p1: I'm a Computer Science student at <1>Université Laval</1> with a growing focus on backend engineering, system architecture, and infrastructure — alongside a deep interest in cybersecurity and building secure systems.
about.p2: I enjoy building APIs, working with databases, designing software systems, and understanding what happens behind the applications we use every day. My current journey is centered around Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Linux, Docker, networking, and cloud technologies — and I'm always exploring ways to make those systems more secure, from threat modeling to hardening infrastructure.
about.p3: I learn by building, experimenting, and sharing what I discover — while documenting my growth publicly through content creation and live coding on <1>YouTube</1> and <2>Twitch</2>.
about.p4: Outside of tech, you'll usually find me playing video games, watching anime, drawing, listening to music, or exploring new ideas.

contact.title: Get In Touch
contact.description: I'm currently open to new opportunities and always happy to connect! Whether you have a project idea, a question, or just want to say hi, feel free to reach out — I'll do my best to get back to you.
